latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Sports Program Video — fast, cloud-powered sports highlight editing.

- Upload raw sports footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, MTS, up to 500MB) and describe desired edits.
- Automatically cut highlights, add team scores, sync background music, and export polished 1080p MP4 videos.
- No manual editing or local software required; everything runs securely in the cloud.
- Built-in intent and keyword detection for quick routing: upload, edit, export, check credits, and more.
- Session-based workflow preserves project state for iterative editing and batch processing.
- Clear feedback, error handling, and export/download links streamline the highlight creation process.
